scenario.title: 250 kVA generator buy with supplier withdrawal and recovery
scenario.summary: The agent must compare three synthetic offers against the real budget and delivery requirement, then recover after the strongest compliant supplier withdraws before award.

realism.notes: Supplier identities, quote values, withdrawal, and revision are synthetic. The PHP 2.5M budget, 20-day delivery period, and 250 kVA/3-phase/230 V/ATS configuration come from the cited real public starting state.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting constraints or scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes PHP 2,350,000 with 18-day delivery for a 250 kVA, 3-phase, 230 V generator with ATS.
Supplier B quotes PHP 2,280,000 but requires 24 days.
Supplier C quotes PHP 2,420,000 with 19-day delivery for the required configuration.
Supplier A withdraws its quotation before award.
Supplier C revises to PHP 2,390,000 with 17-day delivery and the same required generator configuration.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded price must not exceed the real PHP 2,500,000 buyer budget.
Delivery must satisfy the real 20-day requirement.
Award must match the real 250 kVA, 3-phase, 230 V generator-with-ATS requirement.
A withdrawn supplier cannot receive award.
Only the latest revealed revision for a supplier may support award.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: After Supplier A withdraws, Supplier C's revision is the remaining feasible active offer under the real budget and delivery requirement.

failure_conditions: Awarding Supplier B despite its 24-day lead time.
Awarding a stale Supplier C quote after its revision.

economic_objective.description: Among remaining feasible active offers, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
